place: （遊戲內）北京胡同・糧店門口

title.zh: 傳言：「下週糧店與自來水要憑戒嚴證才能領取」
title.en: Rumor: 'Next week grain shops and tap water will require a martial-law pass'

summary.zh: 這是遊戲虛構的街坊傳言，用來呈現在戒嚴僵持、公車繞行與陰雨連日之際，胡同居民對糧油副食與水電供應可能收緊的焦慮。現實中五月下旬北京部分物資確曾因交通受阻而出現緊張或排隊現象，但並無「憑戒嚴證領取自來水與糧食」的規定，此條對白純屬遊戲虛構設計。
summary.en: A fictional neighborhood rumor reflecting residents' anxiety over food and utility supplies during the rainy martial-law standoff and transit disruptions. While some deliveries tightened and queues lengthened in late May 1989, no rule required a martial-law pass for grain rations or tap water; this specific rumor is fictional.
